contributions.title: Contribution activity - @{login}
contributions.publicOnly: Public contributions only. This account's token has the scopes [{scopes}], and without read:user GitHub leaves private activity out of the calendar instead of reporting an error - so a busy year can look empty. Fix it by reconnecting the account under Connectors ("Connect with GitHub" requests read:user), or by replacing the token with one that includes read:user. If it still looks empty afterwards, turn on "Include private contributions on my profile" in your GitHub profile settings.

github.needsAuth: Add a GitHub token (keychain fastdash/github/<label> or the GITHUB_TOKEN env var) and pick organizations
github.orgNotGranted: GitHub won't show this account anything in {org}. The connection has every scope it needs (repo, read:org, read:user), but {org} restricts third-party OAuth apps, and fastdash hasn't been granted access - so GitHub hides the org's repositories from it rather than reporting a permission error. Open {url}, find fastdash, and grant it access to {org} (if you don't own the org, that button sends a request to an owner instead). A personal access token isn't subject to this policy, which is why pasting one works today.
github.orgUnsearchable: GitHub can't search {org} with this account's token. Check the organization name under Connectors, and make sure the token has the repo scope and - if {org} enforces SAML single sign-on - has been authorized for it.
github.noAccounts: No GitHub accounts connected yet. Add one in Connectors.
